name: Avex Inc.
summary: Avex Inc., an entertainment company, engages in music, artist management, animation, visual content, and other businesses in Japan. It operates through three segments: music, anime & visual content, and overseas segments. The company plans, produces, and sells musical content; publishes and distributes music; and plans, produces, and manages concerts and events. It also manages artists, talents, and creators; operates and manages fan clubs; and sells tickets.
